announcement.text: I am pleased to announce today that, with Your Holiness' consent, these 21 martyrs will be included in the Roman Martyrology as a sign of the spiritual communion uniting our two Churches.
announcement.notes: 11 May 2023. Vatican News same day: 20 Egyptian, 1 from Ghana; video showed the men praying as they died. The Arabic cry is spelled variously (Ya Rabbi Yasou / Ya Rabb Yesua): left out of the book.
